Pho Thin - Delicious & Huge Portions
Aug 2026 • Family
Pho Thin 13 Lò Đúc was another great pho experience in Hanoi! My daughter recommended it from her previous trip, so we had to give it a try. I thought the pho was delicious, and the portion was huge! They definitely don’t skimp on the beef! There was so much of it! They only have one size, and it was more than enough for me. I couldn’t even finish the bowl. Definitely come hungry!

Famous Four Shops (authentic)
Aug 2024 • Family
Affiliated or unrelated stores of the same name? I arrived paying attention to this. The most famous restaurant in Hanoi, Pho Bo (beef pho) is the only item on the list, and you tell the old man at the entrance whether you want to attach quantity and oil gruel or not, and whether coriander can be added. I'm delighted to say that I've arrived soon after and added tabletop lime, chili peppers and chasing nyocum as appropriate. Beef bone and beef broth is a good soup, which fits in with crisp rice noodles and is quite delicious. The amount is not small portions like Taiwanese noodles, and it is equivalent to Japanese ramen, so you won't be unhappy.
